description: This Java class 'TSProjectConsumer' is responsible for processing and generating configuration files related to TunerStudio. It reads specific sections from input files, writes configuration data, handles file I/O, and integrates with other classes such as 'ConfigDefinition', 'VariableRegistry', and 'ConfigStructure'.

classes.name: TSProjectConsumer
classes.description: A class implementing ConfigurationConsumer to handle reading, processing, and writing TunerStudio configuration files, managing file sections and variable substitutions.

methods.name: writeTunerStudioFile
methods.description: Reads a TunerStudio file, extracts prefix and postfix sections around configuration definitions, and writes an updated configuration file including additional sections and comments.

methods.name: readTsFile
methods.description: Reads the input TunerStudio file, extracts and separates the content before the CONFIG_DEFINITION_START marker and after the CONFIG_DEFINITION_END marker, applying variable substitutions to the latter.

methods.name: startFile
methods.description: Initialization logic for starting file processing (currently empty).

methods.name: endFile
methods.description: Finalizes processing by writing the constructed TunerStudio configuration file.

methods.name: handleEndStruct
methods.description: Handles the end of a configuration structure, calculating its size, updating the total size, and registering it in the variable registry.
